description:
Publishes a post that already exists — the approval half of "let the agent draft it and I will approve". Irreversible and public.

Needs the posts:publish scope, which keys do not carry unless asked for. Only call this when the user has confirmed this specific post should go out now; if they have not, leave it as a draft and tell them how to review it. Returns the permalink for each channel it reached.
name: planify_publish_post
title: Planify: publish an existing post now
